entries.reason: Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.existing.override. Edit an existing post type (Posts, Pages, Media or one registered by a theme or plugin such as WooCommerce products) (WPE_HARD, P0_PARITY).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.existing.labels-menu. Rename an existing post type and change its menu icon and menu position (WPE_HARD, P0_PARITY).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.existing.supports. Add or remove editor features of an existing post type (comments, excerpt, author, thumbnail, revisions, custom fields, page attributes) (NATIVE_HARD, P0_NATIVE).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.existing.visibility-urls. Change visibility and URLs of an existing post type (public, show in menu, archive, rewrite slug, REST exposure, search exclusion) (WPE_HARD, P1_CORE).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.existing.disable. Hide or disable a built-in post type (for example Posts on a site that only uses Pages) with content kept (WPE_HARD, P2_COMPETITIVE).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.existing.revert. Revert an existing post type to its original registration and show what is overridden (WPE_EXCEED, P1_EXCEED).

Gap closure 2026-11-20 for existing WordPress, theme and plugin objects; one-to-one projection of cpt.safety.unregister-core. Unregistering core post types (post, page, attachment, revision, nav_menu_item, wp_block, wp_template) (REJECTED_UNSAFE, NOT_SCHEDULED).
